max_temp_prediction: The NWP consensus clusters around 85–87°F, with a model-weighted central estimate near 86°F under sunny skies and light southwesterly flow — conditions that support efficient daytime heating without moisture-limiting the high. The D1_NOW bucket distribution's top even bucket of 82–83°F at only 19.6% appears too conservative relative to where the deterministic models are pointing, suggesting the distribution is quite spread and uncertain. Confidence is moderate: the NWS text at 85°F and NBM at 84.7°F anchor the lower bound, while GFS and HRRR push toward 87°F, making a landing near 86°F the most defensible single estimate — likely in the 86–87°F even bucket rather than 82–83°F.
